'''Scorcher505 UTINNI!!! ... if you dare''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Scorcher505]]
* '''Published:''' 8 November 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Jawa Camp|Premiere-L-tatooinejawacamp.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Tatooine: Jawa Camp
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PSE Tatooine Jawa Camp Scorcher505 LS UTINNIif.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

I made this deck to scare some of my friends with power ground decks. It is not designed to win often, but if funny to use and have TONS of ground power with Jawas, plus it is a pain for your opponent.
